title: New-episode notifications
description: Serves "They hear when something new arrives."; "Their data is theirs.". The owner: alerts may pass through Apple's and Google's notification services (D-145): opt-in, off by default, with no title or detail.
acceptanceCriteria: A new episode of a show a viewer follows is marked for them in the app.
A viewer who turns notifications on gets one through their device's notification service; it is off until they turn it on, and the operator can turn it off for the server.

A notification carries no title, no detail and nothing about what the viewer watches, only that something new is waiting; the app fetches the details from the operator's server. A test reads what is sent.
docs/access.md states exactly what leaves the operator's servers, and when.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.

No service run by the Octave or jellyscale project carries a notification. The operator's server sends each one through the device's own notification service, as JS-225 found possible. A platform where it is not possible gets a brief to the product owner, not a relay.
notes: Amended 2026-11-27 by D-20261127-notifications-verify-first, decided by the product owner: dependsOn adds JS-225, the spike that comes first, and criterion 6 is added. PRODUCT.md is unchanged until JS-225 reports.
